visualCharacteristics.purpose: page intro copy beside a boxed callout (heading + bulleted list)
visualCharacteristics.description: No existing columns variants in blocks/. Distinguished by an asymmetric ~60/40 split where the second column is rendered as a light grey callout box with a red left accent border.

contentPattern.summary: Intro paragraphs (left) beside the boxed 'Common Applications' heading + list (right)
contentPattern.structure: one row with two cells: (1) intro paragraphs with inline links, (2) a heading (h3) followed by a bulleted list, rendered as a grey callout box with a red left accent; ~60/40 split on desktop, stacked on mobile

structure.notes: Two columns, one content row. Additional rows would need the same 2 cells.

reuseGuidance: Use when a two-cell row pairs body copy with a short heading + list callout. For equal-weight columns without a callout box use plain columns.
usageDescription: Page intro: descriptive paragraphs on the left with a boxed list of key applications/highlights on the right.
